fine_compaction.practicality: IMPRACTICAL — requires crossbar/indirection (non-systolic), abandons the frozen 8x8 array; index+value metadata and sparse-detection become new bottlenecks

conclusion: No practical fine-grained mechanism converts the 59.08% MAC sparsity into cycle savings on the frozen 8x8 DSP48E2 systolic array: gating (A/C) saves neither cycles nor (on DSP48E2) energy; compaction (B) is a different architecture.
